thread:
Maya (Product): quick sync — we need to lock the staging plan for the Private Onramp pilot with Acme. Customer wants a VPC staging mirror + audit logs. timeline: target beta by Apr 28.
Sam (Eng): timeline feels tight but doable if infra preps are minimal. what are the absolute must-haves from security/compliance?
Rachel (Security): for pilot we need: 1) KMS integration 2) audit log retention 90d 3) access controls mapped to Okta groups. can skip full pen-test for pilot but need threat model signoff.
Li (Runtime): runtime changes: kv-cache isolation per-tenant, option to pin quantized variant, and a deploy path that can fallback to hosted model if private nodes fail. KV isolation will add ~2w of work if we do strict mem separation.
Alex (Infra): infra tasks: VPC peering, private control plane endpoint, ELB + health checks in staging, cert rotation. estimate 3 infra sprints unless we borrow existing infra from beta bucket.
Priya (Eng-Platform): we can reuse the dedicated staging cluster config but need to enable customer-level logging forwarding. that’s ~3-5 days of work.
Maya (Product): ok — we need to prioritize what goes into MVP vs stretch. MVP must satisfy Acme's legal: KMS + logs + single-tenant runtime isolation. Pen-test and multi-region are stretch.
Sam (Eng): to meet Apr 28 MVP we need parallel workstreams: infra + kms + runtime isolation. who owns the KMS integration?
Rachel (Security): security will own KMS design and tests, but Eng-Platform executes the implementation with our guidance.
Priya (Eng-Platform): noted. timeline: if security finishes design by Mar 30, we can implement by Apr 10 and test Apr 11–15.
Li (Runtime): can start work on a lightweight tenant isolation flag that scopes KV keys and sets a tenant prefix. that reduces memory uplift and cuts work to ~5 dev days + 3 days QA if we accept logical isolation rather than strict mem cgroup.
Alex (Infra): we can fast-path VPC peering by cloning the existing private-control-plane template. need infra approval for IP ranges and routing — pinging @Sam for confirmation.
Sam (Eng): confirmed — go ahead with cloning approach, but add a draining window for traffic cutover.
Maya (Product): rollout plan draft: 1) internal staging smoke (team) 2) customer staging with limited test tenants (Acme devs) 3) gradual beta with telemetry. gating criteria before customer staging: KMS working, logs-forwarding working, access controls validated, runtime isolation enabled.
Rachel (Security): add: must pass automated secrets scan and threat model review.
Priya (Eng-Platform): telemetry checklist: token-level cost breakdown, per-tenant latency p95, KV hit rate, and error rate. I’ll add dashboards.
Li (Runtime): one more constraint — the runtime fallback path to hosted model requires feature flags in router. we need a quick rollback script for private nodes. I can add that in 2 days.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline report: staging-template job failed on lint: infra/templates/vpc.yaml: line 42 - missing tags.
Alex (Infra): I’ll fix the template now.
Sam (Eng): blockers: QA bandwidth in Apr 18–22 week is low. can we schedule a focused QA window Apr 11–15 instead?
Maya (Product): yes — moving customer staging earlier is fine as long as Acme can participate. @Alex pls confirm infra can hit Apr 10–12 finish.
Alex (Infra): aiming for Apr 9 completion, will know by EOD tomorrow.
Rachel (Security): security signoff window: Apr 13–16. if infra completes Apr 9 and Eng-Platform finishes Apr 11, security can do review Apr 13.
Priya (Eng-Platform): dashboard + logging forward ready Apr 11 in my plan.
Sam (Eng): ok action items: - Rachel: KMS design by 2024-03-30 - Priya: logging + dashboards by 2024-04-11 - Li: runtime tenant-flag + rollback script by 2024-04-12 - Alex: infra template fix + VPC peering by 2024-04-09 - Maya: coordinate Acme for staging window Apr 11–15
Maya (Product): documenting acceptance criteria here: KMS ops + rotation test, logs forwarded and queryable, p95 latency < 250ms on staging with 20% load, KV hit rate >= 70%, access groups mapped.
Sam (Eng): noted. we should add a canary traffic step where we route 1% Acme traffic through private nodes and monitor.
Li (Runtime): canary route + autoscale policy will be added; propose 1% -> 10% -> 100% over 48h if metrics look good.
Maya (Product): agreed. final Q: any hard blockers that would push beta past Apr 28?
Alex (Infra): only if IP-range approval takes longer or template rebuild hits unknown infra conflicts. otherwise green.
Rachel (Security): if threat model surfaces high-severity items — could delay. we’ll flag early.
Sam (Eng): QA bandwidth risk. consider hiring a short-term QA contractor or shifting some tickets from feature backlog.
Maya (Product): ok let's reconvene tomorrow EOD for a go/no-go. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): thanks — will follow up with a PR for the tenant-flag RFC.
Li (Runtime): will post runtime design doc in #eng-runtime.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I’ll create dashboards and link to thread.
Rachel (Security): will schedule threat-model slot.
Alex (Infra): template fix deployed, re-run CI.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline report: staging-template job succeeded on re-run.
